description: This file defines a function to run workflow tasks within the vtiger CRM system, including various external dependencies needed for session management, webservices, utilities, and email modules.

classes.name: VTWorkflowUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing workflow-related helper methods such as retrieving the admin user.

classes.name: VTTaskQueue
classes.description: Class managing task queue operations, including fetching ready tasks.

classes.name: VTTaskManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing workflow tasks, including retrieval of individual tasks.

classes.name: VTWorkflowEntity
classes.description: Represents workflow entities in the system, instantiated with a user context and entity ID.

classes.name: VTTask
classes.description: Represents a workflow task with methods to execute its logic.

methods.name: vtRunTaskJob
methods.description: Main function that fetches ready tasks from the queue and executes them for the admin user.
